page.layout: One page of text, single column of Latin and Hebrew dictionary entries; no margin notes. Page number 267 at top left, running head "פר" centred at top; signature "M 2" at foot.

main_text.p: fructibus dictus, cum א redundante. Quidam deducunt à פֵּאָר.
main_text.l: פְּרוּר פְּרִוִּים m. Suburbium: plur. פְּרָוִים.
פְּרָזוֹת f. p. Pagi: פְּרָזִי Paganus.
פְּרָזְלָא פְּרָזֶל m. Chald. Ferrum. Heb. פַּרְזֶל.
פָּרַח Florescere, Effloresere, Germinare. Hiphil הֶפְרִיחַ Florere fecit, Floruit.
פֶּרַח m. Flos, Germen: plur. פְּרָחִים.
פָּרַס Partiri, Dividere. Quandoque ס commutatur in ש. Hiphil הִפְרִיס idem.
פָּרַס Chald. idem: Particip. plur. וּפָּרְסִין dividunt, Dan. 5. 25. fœm. פְּרִיסַת Divisum est, Dan. 5.28.
פַּרְסָה f. Ungula: plur. פַּרְסוֹת & פַּרְסִים.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vocalisation is approximate; the scan is faded at the right edge, where lines are cut off (e.g. "Quandoque ס com-", "Divisum", "Abjicere"). Right edge of several lines is partly illegible.
